source_snapshot.title: Dubai Airport gets faster internet: DXB rolls out 5G+ with download speeds exceeding 3Gbps
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Dubai International Airport (DXB) announced it has upgraded its mobile network to 5G+, with peak download speeds exceeding 3 gigabits per second (Gbps), following a partnership between Dubai Airports and UAE telecom operator du..Sign up for our daily business newsletter, Cheques & Balances.The upgrade, announced on Tuesday, aims to improve mobile internet speeds and network capacity across the airport's indoor spaces, where high passenger volumes can put pressure on connectivity.For travellers, the upgrade could mean faster downloads, video calls and access to online services while waiting for flights. However, actual speeds will depend on device compatibility, network congestion and mobile subscriptions.The upgrade applies to mobile connectivity rather than the airport's public Wi-Fi network. DXB, the world's busiest airport for international passenger traffic, handled 95.2 million passengers in 2025.Airport operationsBeyond passenger connectivity, the network will support the airport's digital operations and the introduction of new technologies.“At DXB, connectivity is more than just guest convenience. It is a core part of the digital infrastructure that supports smoother journeys, more responsive operations and an enabler of future airport technology,” said Omar Binadai, Chief Technology and Infrastructure Officer at Dubai Airports.Saleem Alblooshi, Chief Technology Officer at du, said achieving speeds exceeding 3Gbps in a complex indoor environment marked a milestone for the telecom operator.The companies did not disclose the cost of the network upgrade or provide details on average download speeds passengers can expect.The deployment comes ahead of the busy winter travel season, as Dubai Airports continues to invest in infrastructure and technology while rebuilding passenger traffic following months of regional aviation disruptions..Dubai International Airport sees 50.4 million passengers in 9 months, but traffic remains 28% lower in 2026.Dubai International has served 1.5 billion passengers since opening in 1960.Dubai’s visitor boom clears runway for DWC expansion .Dubai Airport to alert shopping, dining passengers about departure time at checkout counters

source_verification.reason: All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

claims.claim: В международном аэропорту Дубая (DXB) обновили мобильную сеть до 5G+, обеспечив пиковую скорость загрузки более 3 Гбит/с.
Улучшение направлено на повышение скорости интернета и пропускной способности сети в помещениях аэропорта, где большое число пассажиров создает нагрузку на связь.
Обновленная сеть поддержит не только мобильный интернет для пассажиров, но и цифровые операции аэропорта, способствуя внедрению новых технологий.
Скорость зависит от совместимости устройств и загруженности сети.
